definitions.explanation: The return of money that was overpaid or is owed back, especially in official or administrative contexts such as tax refunds, insurance reimbursements, and government payments. More formal than everyday words for refunds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{還付|かんぷ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦{確定申告|かくていしんこく}→確定申告：04902_kakuteishinkoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧{還付金|かんぷきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{戻|もど}って→戻る：01117_modoru⟧きた。
examples.english: After filing my tax return, I got a refund back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医療費|いりょうひ}→医療費：24692_iryouhi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{還付|かんぷ}{申請|しんせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{済|す}ませて→済む：01950_sumu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please complete the application for medical expense reimbursement by the deadline.

examples.japanese: {過払|かばら}い⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{還付|かんぷ}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{数週間|すうしゅうかん}→数週間：21615_suushuukan⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The refund process for overpayments may take several weeks.

notes:
Composed of {還|かん} (return, give back) and {付|ふ} (attach, deliver), with voicing ふ→ぷ. The word carries an official, administrative tone — it is the standard term used in tax, insurance, and government contexts, rather than in casual shopping situations.

The most common context is ⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{還付|かんぷ} (tax refund), which many residents of Japan encounter during ⟦{確定申告|かくていしんこく}→確定申告：04902_kakuteishinkoku⟧ (annual tax filing). The derived noun {還付金|かんぷきん} (refund money) is also very frequent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {還付金|かんぷきん}: refund money
- {還付|かんぷ}{申請|しんせい}: refund application
- {還付|かんぷ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a refund
- ⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{還付|かんぷ}: tax refund
- {還付|かんぷ}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: refund process/procedure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{返金|へんきん}→返金：06130_henkin⟧: refund — the general everyday word for getting money back (e.g., from a store)
- {払|はら}い{戻|もど}し: reimbursement, payout — used for insurance payouts and refunds
- ⟦{返還|へんかん}→返還：14357_henkan⟧: return, restitution — returning something (not only money) to its rightful owner
